description: The data statuses the code branches on, one entry each: their values, how a value moves to another (full weight: a transition table the shared helper scripts/lib/state-machine.mjs runs), the spellings found in the data and what they mean, and the labels the site shows. Ids are those of the state-machine catalogue (D:/civgraph-intake/refactor-2026-11-07/state-machines, RG-01 to RG-06). Every value and rule is copied from the code or data named in its `sources`; tests/unit/registries-statuses.test.mjs holds each to them. Schema: packages/registries/schemas/statuses.schema.json; views: packages/registries/src/statuses.mjs.

contribution.about: A contribution queued by POST /_api/contributions/submit: reviewed in /_api/contributions/decide, applied locally by scripts/intake/contributions.mjs. Approving applies nothing; only an approved submission can be marked applied.
sources: functions/_api/contributions/decide.js (decision must be approved or rejected)

election-round.about: A pre-1973 NI council round, from the intake to the map. The intake's work status and calendar entry (data/elections/ni-local/round-status.json) and the round's completeness (data/elections/round-completeness.json) decide its site status: every published round starts complete and only moves down.

siteRules.when: excluded from apply, and still complete
round-completeness has text and is not complete, and still complete

election-round.missingWhen: the calendar says held, the work is not no-election, and no round of the council is published that year

candidate-count.about: A candidate's Status on a count row. Blank means still in the count (continuing); the count ends with each candidate elected, excluded or not elected. statusKind (src/election-domain.mjs) folds the spellings.

correction.about: A reviewed correction record in data/elections/corrections/walker-*.json. The manifest build applies only records whose status is applied.

contest.about: Whether a contest went to a poll. The data audit reads a missing value as contested; the map labels them Polled and Returned unopposed.

intake-batch.about: An intake batch's manifest status (its lifecycle machine is rf-ingest's IN-01).

register-interests-availability.about: Whether an NI register-of-interests source is structured data, or a document that is available or not.

peatland-publication.about: How a Peatland Geoportal source is published.

peatland-link.about: What a Peatland Geoportal source link is.

dobih-archive.about: Whether a DoBIH source item is mirrored to the Internet Archive.

dobih-publication.about: How a DoBIH asset is published: two facts in one value, separated by '; '.
